info.title: Sinag API
info.description: Sinag — bukas na abot-kamay. REST API for accounts, transfers, spending categories and the operations review queue. Demo project. Not a licensed bank.

tags.name: Transaction categories
tags.description: AI-assisted filing of transactions under spending categories

tags.name: Transfers
tags.description: Moving money between two accounts in one transaction

tags.name: Reconciliation
tags.description: ADMIN-only money-integrity check: the ledger against the stored balances

tags.name: Anomaly flags
tags.description: ADMIN review of money movements the anomaly rules flagged

tags.name: Assistant
tags.description: Claude-powered chat over the caller's own accounts

put.description: ADMIN only. Records REVIEWED or DISMISSED, who decided and when. A decision is one-way: an already closed flag is a 409.

200.description: Flag closed; the updated flag is returned

422.description: Status is not REVIEWED or DISMISSED

429.description: More than 60 requests in one minute for this user; Retry-After says how long to wait

put.summary: Store a category for a transaction
put.description: Accepts a suggested category or stores one chosen by hand. The code must be one of the documented vocabulary values; anything else is a 422.

200.description: Category stored; the updated transaction is returned

404.description: Account or transaction not found, or not the caller's

422.description: Category code is not in the vocabulary

429.description: More than 60 requests in one minute for this user; Retry-After says how long to wait

post.description: Records TRANSFER_OUT on the source and TRANSFER_IN on the destination. The caller must own the source account; the destination may belong to anyone. Requires an Idempotency-Key header; replaying the same key with the same body returns the stored response without transferring again.

200.description: Transfer recorded (or replayed); the response is the source account's TRANSFER_OUT entry

404.description: Source account is missing or not the caller's, or the destination does not exist — a CUSTOMER gets the same generic answer for all of them

409.description: Idempotency key already used with a different request

422.description: Invalid amount, same account on both sides, or insufficient funds

429.description: More than 60 requests in one minute for this user; Retry-After says how long to wait

post.description: Always creates a CUSTOMER. ADMIN logins are created by the operator at startup from the ADMIN_PASSWORD environment variable, never through this endpoint.

post.summary: Exchange the refresh token for a new pair
post.description: Call this when the access token expires. An access token sent here is rejected.

401.description: Refresh token is missing, invalid, or expired

post.summary: Log in and receive the token pair
post.description: Returns an access token (send as 'Authorization: Bearer ...') and a long-lived refresh token for later. Repeated failed logins are rate limited with 429.

post.summary: Ask the banking assistant a question
post.description: Runs a tool-calling conversation with Claude. The tools read balances, search transactions and summarize spending, always for the authenticated caller. A requested transfer comes back as a proposal only; confirm it with POST /api/transfers. Requires ANTHROPIC_API_KEY.

422.description: The message is empty or too long

429.description: More than 60 requests in one minute for this user; Retry-After says how long to wait

503.description: The Claude API key is missing, or the assistant did not answer

get.summary: List the accounts the caller may see
get.description: A CUSTOMER gets only the accounts they own; an ADMIN gets every account. Ordered by account number, oldest page first.

429.description: More than 60 requests in one minute for this user; Retry-After says how long to wait

post.description: The bank assigns the account number: 11 digits, drawn on the server. Owned by the calling CUSTOMER (admins create operator accounts with no owner). A positive initial deposit is recorded as the account's first transaction. A customer never hears "that number already exists", because they never choose one.

201.description: Account created, with its assigned number

422.description: Invalid account name or initial deposit

429.description: More than 60 requests in one minute for this user; Retry-After says how long to wait

503.description: No account number could be assigned; safe to retry

post.description: Requires an Idempotency-Key header, same replay rules as deposit.

404.description: Account does not exist, or is not the caller's — a CUSTOMER gets the identical answer for both

409.description: Idempotency key already used with a different request

429.description: More than 60 requests in one minute for this user; Retry-After says how long to wait

post.summary: Suggest a category for a transaction
post.description: Sends the transaction type, amount and an optional description to Claude and returns one code from the closed category vocabulary. The suggestion is NOT stored; accept it with PUT .../category. The account must belong to the caller.

404.description: Account or transaction not found, or not the caller's

429.description: More than 60 requests in one minute for this user; Retry-After says how long to wait

503.description: The Claude API key is missing, or the categorizer did not answer

post.description: Requires an Idempotency-Key header. Replaying the same key with the same body returns the stored response without depositing again.

404.description: Account does not exist, or is not the caller's — a CUSTOMER gets the identical answer for both

409.description: Idempotency key already used with a different request

429.description: More than 60 requests in one minute for this user; Retry-After says how long to wait

post.summary: Open an account with a number the operator chose
post.description: ADMIN only: an operator keys an account opened on paper or in another system. A CUSTOMER calling this is refused with 403, and a number that is taken is a 409.

422.description: Invalid account number, name, or initial deposit

429.description: More than 60 requests in one minute for this user; Retry-After says how long to wait

get.summary: Check that every account balance equals the sum of its ledger rows
get.description: ADMIN only. Read-only: it reports the accounts that do not add up and changes no balance, because a discrepancy has to be explained before it is corrected.

200.description: Report; reconciled=false lists the mismatching accounts

429.description: More than 60 requests in one minute for this user; Retry-After says how long to wait

get.description: ADMIN only. Without a status filter every flag is listed; status=OPEN is the review queue. Flags never block or reverse a transaction.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: OPEN, REVIEWED or DISMISSED; omit for every state

429.description: More than 60 requests in one minute for this user; Retry-After says how long to wait

get.summary: Get one account by account number

404.description: Account does not exist, or is not the caller's — a CUSTOMER gets the identical answer for both

429.description: More than 60 requests in one minute for this user; Retry-After says how long to wait

get.summary: Transaction history of an account, oldest first

404.description: Account does not exist, or is not the caller's — a CUSTOMER gets the identical answer for both

429.description: More than 60 requests in one minute for this user; Retry-After says how long to wait

ReviewAnomalyFlagRequest.description: An admin's decision about an anomaly flag

AnomalyFlagResponse.description: A rule finding about one transaction, waiting for or closed by an ADMIN review

amount.description: Flagged amount as a decimal string

details.description: What the rule saw, in words
details.example: 5000.00 is at least 3x the 100.00 average of the last 3 outbound transactions (flag floor 1000.00).

createdAt.description: When the flag was raised, ISO-8601

reviewedAt.description: When an admin closed the flag, absent while OPEN

reviewedBy.description: Admin who closed the flag, absent while OPEN

SetCategoryRequest.description: The category the account owner accepted for a transaction

category.description: One code from the category vocabulary

TransactionResponse.description: One entry of an account's transaction history

accountNumber.description: Account number exactly as the request spelled it

type.description: DEPOSIT, WITHDRAW, TRANSFER_OUT (source side) or TRANSFER_IN (destination side)

amount.description: Moved amount as a decimal string

balanceAfter.description: Balance of the account AFTER this transaction

referenceAccount.description: Other account of a transfer, absent for deposit and withdraw

description.description: Customer-supplied note, absent when the movement had none

createdAt.description: When the transaction was recorded, ISO-8601

category.description: Accepted category, absent until someone categorizes the transaction

TransferRequest.description: Request body for a transfer between two accounts

sourceAccountNumber.description: Account to take the money from

destinationAccountNumber.description: Account to put the money into

amount.description: Amount as a decimal string: greater than zero, at most two decimal places

description.description: Optional note stored on both sides of the transfer, at most 255 characters

RegisterRequest.description: Request body for registering a login

username.description: 3 to 50 characters: lowercase letters, digits, dot, underscore, hyphen

RefreshRequest.description: Request body for refreshing an expired access token

refreshToken.description: The refresh token received at login

TokenResponse.description: Token pair returned by login and refresh

accessToken.description: Send on every API call as 'Authorization: Bearer <accessToken>'

refreshToken.description: Long-lived; send it to /api/auth/refresh when the access token expires

tokenType.description: Token type for the Authorization header

AssistantChatRequest.description: One chat message for the banking assistant

message.example: How much did I spend on groceries this month?

AssistantChatResponse.description: The assistant's answer and the read-only lookups behind it

toolCalls.description: Tool calls executed for this answer, in order

transferProposals.description: Transfers proposed but NOT executed; empty when none were proposed

AssistantToolCallResponse.description: One read-only tool call the assistant executed for this answer

arguments.description: Arguments after unknown model-supplied fields were removed

TransferProposalResponse.description: A transfer the assistant suggested but did not execute

CreateAccountRequest.description: Request body for opening an account. There is no account number: the bank assigns it.

accountName.description: Account holder name, at most 100 characters

initialDeposit.description: Opening deposit as a decimal string; zero creates the account without a transaction

balance.description: Balance in pesos with two decimal places

createdAt.description: When the account was created, ISO-8601

AmountRequest.description: Request body with an amount and an optional note

amount.description: Amount as a decimal string: greater than zero, at most two decimal places

description.description: Optional note stored with the transaction, at most 255 characters

CategorySuggestionRequest.description: Optional detail that helps the categorizer; the transaction itself is found by id

description.description: Free-text note such as a merchant or purpose (at most 500 characters are used)

CategorySuggestionResponse.description: A suggested category; nothing is stored until the caller accepts it

transactionId.description: Transaction the suggestion was made for

CreateAccountWithNumberRequest.description: Request body for an ADMIN opening an account with a chosen number

accountNumber.description: Account number chosen by the operator, at most 20 characters

accountName.description: Account holder name, at most 100 characters

initialDeposit.description: Opening deposit as a decimal string; zero creates the account without a transaction

DiscrepancyResponse.description: One account whose ledger does not match its stored balance

ledgerBalance.description: Balance the ledger implies, as a decimal string

storedBalance.description: Balance stored on the account, as a decimal string

difference.description: Ledger minus stored balance: positive means the ledger holds more than the account

ReconciliationResponse.description: Result of comparing every account's stored balance with the sum of its ledger rows

reconciled.description: True when every account's balance equals its ledger

ledgerTotal.description: Sum of the ledger over those accounts, as a decimal string

storedTotal.description: Sum of the stored balances, as a decimal string

discrepancies.description: Accounts that do not add up, by account number

discrepanciesTruncated.description: True when more accounts mismatched than could be listed here

AnomalyFlagPageResponse.description: One page of anomaly flags, newest first

totalElements.description: Total number of flags matching the filter

AccountPageResponse.description: One page of the accounts the caller may see, ordered by account number

totalElements.description: Total number of accounts for this caller

TransactionPageResponse.description: One page of an account's transaction history, oldest first

totalElements.description: Total number of transactions for the account
